label: context.reference
text:
Use the bound world_mcp_unity Application and its current tool and resource catalogs. Resolve the intended Editor and project, then inspect the scene, asset or code involved in the task. Available operations and their argument schemas come from the connected server; a descriptor alone does not mean the Editor is open or ready.

Invoke catalog tools through unity.call_tool and resources through unity.read_resource; unity.get_prompt exposes declared prompts. Refresh the tool catalogue or connection status when the observation requires it. Follow returned job identifiers, pagination and compilation state rather than guessing completion.

Choose verification for the change: the relevant asset or scene state, compilation, test, play behavior or build result. Use visual evidence when the requested result is visual and observation is available. Report the actual outcome and any missing dependency.
